title: Engineering review P1 remainders
description:
Parts of the merged P1 tasks that were deliberately left for follow-up (see the PR bodies for #417 through #423):
- CI/release (kbs-9fe83b63): pin platform-ci by SHA; develop ruleset and required-check changes (needs admin); PyPI Trusted Publishing (registry side).
- Cloud auth (kbs-e6aa4c29): verify the MQTT authorizer; scope the Cognito identity-pool role; webhook secrets; map error types to HTTP statuses.
- Local console (kbs-7e29e0da): decide the default bind host story (kbsc binds 0.0.0.0).
- File fidelity (kbs-232185): golden cross-runtime parity test (overlaps kbs-eb1788eb).
- Board load (kbs-73f796e3): remaining quadratic callers (ready, dep add, dep tree, update --type).
